Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.
Bonus Tracks from various cd single rips and others obtained from other posts on here.

I don't have access to my CD drive at the moment to re-rip "Choosey Lover" from the album directly. I made an edit and separated the 2 versions into 2 separate tracks.

The "New School" version is just the "New School" version as it's own track.

For the "Old School" Version, When Aaliyah sings "I'm so glad you choose me And I'll make you so happy" for the first time, there's a slight pause in vocals before it goes into verse 1. When she sings it for the last time before it goes into the "new school" Version, I placed a repeat of the first time and that slight pause, then faded it out.

item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - [REQ AUD] M2M - Don't Mess With My Love (Acoustic) in FLAC
item.description:
So lately quite a while back... I was building a Discography Collection of M2M in FLAC.
I somehow managed to have Five Versions of Shades of Purple and Four Versions of The Big Room then two Compilation Albums and two EPs about almost all of the singles.

But unfortunately when it comes to the Singles i couldn't get my hands on "Pretty Boy" and "Everything You Do" as i couldn't find a FLAC Copy of this specific track.
I had some friend that i met on Soulseek and he helped me on finding the singles i need and unfortunately we tried looking for this specific track but unfortunately we came empty handed.
I wonder if anyone of you guys had a FLAC Copy of this track? Thanks.
